tasks.sql: WITH page_stats AS (SELECT page_name, page_url_simple_hash, COUNT(*) AS visit_count, AVG(duration) AS avg_duration FROM appuser.ods_browser_page WHERE local_biz_system_name = 'CRM营业厅' AND accept_time > NOW() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND page_name NOT IN ('', '403错误', '错误提示', 'WPS WebOffice', '客户关系管理系统CRM') AND page_url_simple_hash LIKE ('http://192.168.1.15%') GROUP BY page_name, page_url_simple_hash HAVING visit_count > 30), slow_pages AS (SELECT page_name, page_url_simple_hash, visit_count, avg_duration FROM page_stats WHERE avg_duration > 3000) SELECT page_name as "页面名称", page_url_simple_hash as "页面URL", visit_count as "访问量", ROUND(avg_duration, 0) AS "平均加载时长" FROM slow_pages;

WITH page_stats AS (SELECT page_name, page_url_simple_hash, COUNT(*) AS visit_count, AVG(duration) AS avg_duration FROM appuser.ods_browser_page WHERE local_biz_system_name = 'CRM营业厅' AND accept_time > NOW() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND page_name NOT IN ('', '403错误', '错误提示', 'WPS WebOffice', '客户关系管理系统CRM') GROUP BY page_name, page_url_simple_hash HAVING visit_count > 30), total_visits AS (SELECT SUM(visit_count) AS total_visit_count FROM page_stats), slow_pages AS (SELECT page_name, page_url_simple_hash, visit_count, avg_duration FROM page_stats WHERE avg_duration > 3000) SELECT COUNT(*) AS "慢加载页面个数", groupArray(page_name) AS "慢加载页面名称", groupArray(arrayStringConcat(arraySlice(splitByChar('/', page_url_simple_hash), 4), '/')) AS "慢加载URL", SUM(visit_count) AS "慢访问次数", round((SUM(visit_count) / (SELECT total_visit_count FROM total_visits)) * 100, 2) AS "慢访问占比（%）" FROM slow_pages;
tasks.dataset: 大于3s的页面访问量占比

tasks.sql: WITH request_stats AS (SELECT page_name, request_url_simple, COUNT(*) AS visit_count, AVG(duration) AS avg_duration FROM appuser.ods_browser_request WHERE local_biz_system_name = 'CRM营业厅' AND accept_time > NOW() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND page_name NOT IN ('', '403错误', '错误提示', 'WPS WebOffice', '客户关系管理系统CRM') AND request_url_simple LIKE 'http://192.168.1.15/%' GROUP BY page_name, request_url_simple HAVING visit_count > 30), total_visits AS (SELECT SUM(visit_count) AS total_visit_count FROM request_stats), slow_requests AS (SELECT page_name, request_url_simple, visit_count, avg_duration FROM request_stats WHERE avg_duration > 3000) SELECT page_name as "业务页面名称", request_url_simple as "请求URL（多种渠道端口，取其一）", visit_count as "访问次数", round(avg_duration,0) AS  "响应时长(ms)"  FROM slow_requests ORDER BY round(avg_duration,0) DESC;

WITH request_stats AS (SELECT page_name, request_url_simple, COUNT(*) AS visit_count, AVG(duration) AS avg_duration FROM appuser.ods_browser_request WHERE local_biz_system_name = 'CRM营业厅' AND accept_time > NOW() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND page_name NOT IN ('', '403错误', '错误提示', 'WPS WebOffice', '客户关系管理系统CRM') GROUP BY page_name, request_url_simple HAVING visit_count > 30), total_visits AS (SELECT SUM(visit_count) AS total_visit_count FROM request_stats), slow_requests AS (SELECT page_name, request_url_simple, visit_count, avg_duration FROM request_stats WHERE avg_duration > 3000) SELECT COUNT(*) AS "慢请求个数", groupArray(page_name) AS "所属业务页面", groupArray(arrayStringConcat(arraySlice(splitByChar('/', request_url_simple), 4), '/')) AS  "所属页面URL", SUM(visit_count) AS  "慢请求总访问量", round((SUM(visit_count) / (SELECT total_visit_count FROM total_visits)) * 100, 4) AS "慢请求访问量占比" FROM slow_requests;
tasks.dataset: 响应时长大于3s的请求访问量占比

tasks.sql: SELECT  CASE local_application_id WHEN 'd496c45a-baaa-4848-88bf-8d51e2da130b' THEN 'CRM-web前台' WHEN 'd91e4b33-9063-4a3b-afdd-b055349d39a7' THEN 'CRM-订单中心' WHEN '3d7aff24-ab7f-41e3-8cab-88b0fe6bd5c1' THEN 'CRM-账管中心' WHEN '2cbfc81e-ee5d-4e4b-80bd-433edf4be62d' THEN 'CRM-前台APP' WHEN 'f581c7fd-b3dc-47ae-8ad0-2cdac000184f' THEN 'CRM-接口APP'  ELSE local_application_id END AS "应用",count(1) as "访问量",concat(cast(round(avg(duration),0) as varchar),'ms') as "平均响应耗时" from appuser.dwd_apm_trace_span_service where local_application_id in ('d496c45a-baaa-4848-88bf-8d51e2da130b','d91e4b33-9063-4a3b-afdd-b055349d39a7','3d7aff24-ab7f-41e3-8cab-88b0fe6bd5c1','2cbfc81e-ee5d-4e4b-80bd-433edf4be62d','f581c7fd-b3dc-47ae-8ad0-2cdac000184f') and trace_kind ='APM' and accept_time>= DATE_SUB(now(), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) group by local_application_id order by "应用"

SELECT application_name as "应用",concat(cast(round(sum(value)/1000,0)as varchar),'s')  as "Full GC时长" from appuser.ods_common_metric where application_name in ('CRM-web前台','CRM-订单中心','CRM-账管中心','CRM-前台APP','CRM-接口APP') and metric ='jvm.gc.full-gc.time' and accept_time >= DATE_SUB(now(), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE)  GROUP by application_name order by application_name

SELECT count(1) as "访问量",round(avg(duration),0)  as "平均响应耗时(ms)" from appuser.dwd_apm_trace_span_service  where local_system_id ='2be5e2e6-db53-486a-8e35-bab0bfca6481' and trace_kind ='APM' and service_type ='Accept URL' and url not like '%jsp' and accept_time >= DATE_SUB(now(), INTERVAL 5 DAY)

SELECT COUNT(1) AS "总访问量",COUNT(CASE WHEN duration >= 1000 THEN 1 END) AS "大于1秒的访问量", ROUND( COUNT(CASE WHEN duration >= 1000 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(1), 2 ) AS "占比(%)"  FROM appuser.dwd_apm_trace_span_service  WHERE local_system_id = '2be5e2e6-db53-486a-8e35-bab0bfca6481'  AND trace_kind = 'APM' and service_type ='Accept URL' and url not like '%jsp'  AND accept_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE);
tasks.dataset: 大于1s的接口访问量占比

tasks.sql: SELECT  count(1) as "访问量",round(avg(duration),0) as "平均响应耗时(ms)" from appuser.dwd_apm_trace_span_sql  where local_system_id ='2be5e2e6-db53-486a-8e35-bab0bfca6481' and trace_kind ='APM' and call_type ='SQL' and accept_time >= DATE_SUB(now(), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE)

SELECT COUNT(1) AS "总访问量",COUNT(CASE WHEN duration >= 1000 THEN 1 END) AS "大于1秒的访问量" ,ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN duration >= 1000 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(1),4) AS "占比(%)" FROM appuser.dwd_apm_trace_span_sql WHERE local_system_id = '2be5e2e6-db53-486a-8e35-bab0bfca6481' AND trace_kind = 'APM' AND call_type = 'SQL' AND accept_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE);

SELECT service as "CRM服务接口", COUNT(1) AS "访问量", SUM(CASE WHEN status_code != '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "失败量", round((1-SUM(CASE WHEN status_code != '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(1)) * 100, 2) AS "成功率(%)"  FROM appuser.dwd_apm_trace_span_service WHERE accept_time >= now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND trace_kind = 'APM' AND service_type = 'Accept URL' AND local_system_id = '2be5e2e6-db53-486a-8e35-bab0bfca6481' AND service NOT LIKE '%/probe.jsp' GROUP BY service HAVING count(1) > 1000 ORDER BY "成功率(%)";
tasks.dataset: 后端服务-单个接口的失败次数、成功率

tasks.sql: SELECT CASE application_id WHEN 'd496c45a-baaa-4848-88bf-8d51e2da130b' THEN 'CRM-web前台' WHEN 'd91e4b33-9063-4a3b-afdd-b055349d39a7' THEN 'CRM-订单中心' WHEN '3d7aff24-ab7f-41e3-8cab-88b0fe6bd5c1' THEN 'CRM-账管中心' WHEN '2cbfc81e-ee5d-4e4b-80bd-433edf4be62d' THEN 'CRM-前台APP' WHEN 'f581c7fd-b3dc-47ae-8ad0-2cdac000184f' THEN 'CRM-接口APP' ELSE application_id END AS "应用", type as "异常名称", count(`type`) as "异常次数" FROM appuser.ods_apm_exception WHERE application_id IN ('d496c45a-baaa-4848-88bf-8d51e2da130b','d91e4b33-9063-4a3b-afdd-b055349d39a7','3d7aff24-ab7f-41e3-8cab-88b0fe6bd5c1','2cbfc81e-ee5d-4e4b-80bd-433edf4be62d','f581c7fd-b3dc-47ae-8ad0-2cdac000184f') AND type NOT IN ('com.ailk.biz.exception.BizException','com.ailk.common.BaseException') AND accept_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) GROUP BY application_id, type HAVING count(1) > 50 ORDER BY count(`type`) DESC;
tasks.dataset: 后端服务-实例异常次数

tasks.sql: WITH error_summary AS (SELECT error_type, message, page_url_simple_hash, COUNT(*) AS c FROM appuser.ods_browser_error WHERE local_biz_system_name = 'CRM营业厅' AND accept_time > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND error_source_type = 'javascript' AND message NOT IN ('', 'Uncaught ReferenceError: android_apm is not defined', 'Script error.', 'Unhandled promise rejection: false') GROUP BY error_type, message, page_url_simple_hash HAVING c > 3000), total_records AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count FROM appuser.ods_browser_error WHERE local_biz_system_name = 'CRM营业厅' AND accept_time > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND error_source_type = 'javascript' AND message NOT IN ('', 'Uncaught ReferenceError: android_apm is not defined', 'Script error.')) SELECT es.message as "报错名称", SUM(es.c) AS "报错次数", tr.total_count as "总报错量" FROM error_summary es, total_records tr GROUP BY es.message, tr.total_count ORDER BY "报错次数" DESC;
